title: skills(objectstack-data): teach that a package's translations of its own fieldPatches text now apply (after #33952)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #34784 (Fixes #33952; dev report 6945274012). Dedupe: `fieldPatches translations skills`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits #33952) · domain:skills · Blocked-by #33952

## What is owed

PR #34784 makes a dependent package's translations of its own `fieldPatches` text take effect on `/meta` and on the public form (`Metadata-protocol: semantic`). `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` teaches it in that PR. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, in its `fieldPatches` paragraph, does not yet say that a package translating the labels and help text it patches onto another package's object ships those strings in its own translation bundle, and that they now apply.

Update that paragraph to match the docs page once #34784 merges, and add or adjust the skill's eval so it exercises the rule. Text only; no code.
